mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate increases by more than 0.25% over the next month, higher discount rates reduce the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified FEDFUNDS increase (p > 0.05) or the increase is <0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment (PAYEMS) above 10,000 monthly new jobs triggers wage growth expectations, which lift S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds 10,000 in the following month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS >10,000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer demand proxies (HOUST) by at least 15% over the next quarter is associated with higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by ≥15% over the next 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the identified HOUST surge.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (monthly index) for two consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, which predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the identified INDPRO contraction (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 233.8) for three months increases expectations of rate hikes, which depresses equity discount rates and produces negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL staying above 233.8 (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for the next month signals labor market tightness that boosts investor confidence and drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both retail sales (implied via HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 2023 Q4 averages for the next 20 days indicate a dual-demand recovery, supporting positive returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 2023Q4 and INDPRO > 2023Q4 averages in the next 20 days
regime_hint: Dual demand indicators above historical norms
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the interaction window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer confidence proxies (not available in the catalog; fallback to RSAFS < 400,000 for 5 months) predicts supply-side softness and negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite RSAFS remaining below 400,000 (p < 0.05).
